metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Brazil strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ali, have you thought about what we should give Sarah for her celebration? I was thinking frangipanis could be nice... they’re beautiful and symbolize positivity. What do you think? 

Also, I’ve been wondering... do you really believe one of your main goals in life is to make your parents proud?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis are nice, but I think we should get her something more personal... maybe a nice stethoscope? It’s something she’ll use every day in med school. 

And yeah, absolutely. Making my parents proud is really important to me. I want to show them that all their sacrifices mean something. It drives me every day.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
A stethoscope is practical, I get that. But frangipanis can carry a special meaning too... like a touch of warmth and celebration. 

About making your parents proud... I just wonder if that’s the only thing that drives you. Don’t you have personal goals that matter just as much?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
I get that frangipanis have their meaning, but I still think a stethoscope is more fitting for her future. It’s something she’ll treasure in her journey.

As for my parents, I mean, I have personal goals too, but making them proud is always at the forefront for me. It’s a part of who I am. I don’t think that will ever change.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
I see your point about the stethoscope being fitting... but frangipanis could also represent our support and love for her. 

Regarding making your parents proud, it’s just... it seems like a heavy weight to carry. Shouldn’t your own happiness and goals be just as important?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
I understand that frangipanis represent support and love, but I really think a stethoscope speaks to her future as a doctor. It’s practical and meaningful in that way.

And about making my parents proud, their happiness is tied to mine. It’s not a heavy weight for me; it’s a motivation. My goals will always include making them proud. That’s how I see my own happiness.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
I get that a stethoscope is practical for her future... it just feels a bit impersonal to me. Can we at least consider a combination? Frangipanis to symbolize our friendship and a stethoscope for her career?

And about your parents... I just can’t agree that their pride should be the main driving factor for your happiness. What about your own dreams? Shouldn’t they take center stage?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
I see what you’re saying about the frangipanis symbolizing friendship, and I think combining them with the stethoscope is a great idea. It shows our support for her in both ways, so I’m on board with that.

About making my parents proud, I believe that deep down, we are all the same. We all want to find that balance between our parents’ expectations and our own dreams. At the end of the day, we all have things that motivate us, and it’s just a part of who we are. It’s a small world after all, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Adam
turns.message:
Combining the frangipanis and stethoscope sounds good. It represents both our support and her career path. 

But about what you said... I don’t think everyone sees it that way. Not everyone feels that pressure to meet their parents' expectations. There are plenty of people who prioritize their own dreams and happiness above all else. Isn’t it important to find your own path?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I agree that combining them represents both our support and her career, so I’m glad we’re on the same page there.

As for finding my own path, I think it’s important, but my parents’ expectations are part of that path for me. It’s not just pressure; it’s motivation. I want to honor their sacrifices while pursuing my dreams. That’s my way of achieving happiness.
turns.label: Acceptance

positive.mediator_utterance: I appreciate both of your perspectives on the gifts and the motivations behind them.
